exposure: intratracheal administration of surfactant with budesonide
outcome: bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) at 36 weeks postmenstrual gestational age
cohort: Extremely low birth weight (ELBW) infants with respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) receiving either intratracheal surfactant with budesonide or surfactant alone.
finding: The study found no significant difference in the incidence of death or bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) at 36 weeks postmenstrual gestational age between ELBW infants who received surfactant with budesonide and those who received surfactant alone.
gest_age: Preterm infants; outcome assessed at 36 weeks postmenstrual gestational age
